title: Re-land RAT decision/persistence layer on upstream N5 (one commit)
description: Our differentiator vs upstream's coarser stacked-ifdef N5. On top of upstream mo.cfg/mt.cfg/register.cfg: (1) runtime per-call N5-vs-Rx PRIMARY selection from P-Access-Network-Info (wrap stacked WITH_RX/WITH_N5 in if(reg_tech)); (2) IMPU-keyed sub_tech htable + PANI-absent fallback for in-dialog/MT (upstream keys on source IP only); (3) S-CSCF IMPI->tech (from 32cd768); (4) DEPLOY_MODE=ALL dual-stack (from 247b289). 9 old commits -> 1.
notes: Lesson from discarded working-tree debug of old implementation: in WITHINDLG MSISDN->IMPI lookup, the IMS domain was hardcoded (sip:$rU@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org); fix was templating it as @NETWORKNAME substituted by init script. When re-landing the decision layer, template all domain references — never hardcode mnc/mcc.
close_reason: Implemented BETTER design than planned htable re-land, per user request for alternatives: BSF PCF-binding discovery (Nbsf_management, TS 29.513) as primary RAT/policy-interface selector — GET pcfBindings?ipv4Addr= to BSF: 200=5G-anchored=N5, 404=EPC-anchored=Rx. Layered fallback: BSF -> PANI (stateless) -> upstream RAT htables (demoted to best-effort cache) -> Rx default. New pcscf/route/policy_if.cfg + 7 gate wraps (register Rx/N5-create/N5-dereg, MO initial+indialog, MT initial+indialog). DEPLOY_MODE=4G added (compile out N5). Verified open5gs @dbe060f5 BSF implements discovery (bsf_sess_find_by_ipv4addr, 200/404). kamailio -c passes in docker_kamailio for ALL/5G/4G modes. No S-CSCF changes needed.

title: VoNR: no dedicated 5QI-1 GBR flow created for voice (N5 qosReference not mapped)
description: Found during live two-device VoNR (2026-07-18). Call works with two-way audio but voice rides the DEFAULT flow — no dedicated 5QI-1 GBR bearer. P-CSCF (kamailio) N5 medComponent sends qosReference='qosVoNR' + marBwUl/Dl (pcscf/route/mo.cfg:449, mt.cfg:364, register.cfg:396) but Open5GS PCF does not map that named reference to a 5QI-1 GBR PCC rule. SMF logs 'No need to send Session Modification Request', 'qos_flow_created:0, qos_presence:0, rule_count:0' (binding.c:722). Phone shows only fiveQi=5 (IMS sig) + fiveQi=9 (internet); no fiveQi=1. IMS session default qos in mongo = index 5 / ARP 1. FIX DIRECTIONS: (a) have the N5 request carry explicit qosData (5qi=1 + gbrUl/Dl derived from codec BW) instead of/alongside the qosReference string, OR (b) configure the qosVoNR->5QI-1-GBR mapping in Open5GS PCF if it supports named references. Requires a live call to re-test, so do AFTER coexistence testing. Impact: functional voice but no QoS priority/guaranteed bitrate; not spec-correct VoNR QoS.
notes:
ROOT CAUSE + FIX 2026-07-18: Open5GS PCF ignores the AF qosReference AND the marBw the P-CSCF sends; it picks 5QI by media type (AUDIO->5QI-1 automatically) but takes GBR from the subscriber's preconfigured session PCC rule (matched by qos.index), rejecting the request if none matches. The IMS subscribers HAD a 5QI-1 pcc_rule but its gbr/mbr had unit only, no value (=0), so the flow landed with GBR=0 and the SMF created no dedicated bearer (qos_presence gates on nonzero MBR/GBR; binding.c). FIX: set real values on the ims-session PCC rules in mongo for 001010000116330/331 — 5QI-1 gbr 44 / mbr 64 Kbps, 5QI-2 gbr 512 / mbr 2048 Kbps. PCF re-reads policy per call (pcf_get_session_data), no restart needed. REPRODUCIBILITY: subscriber provisioning must set these GBR/MBR values (webui/dbctl leaves them 0). Retest in progress (VoNR call, expect fiveQi=1 flow on phones + SMF creating the 5QI-1 GBR flow).
Reproducibility SOLVED: added provisioning/set_ims_voice_qos.sh — idempotent helper that sets 5QI-1 (44/64) + 5QI-2 (512/2048 Kbps) GBR/MBR on the ims-APN PCC rules for one/several/all subscribers. Run after adding an IMS subscriber. Normalized all existing IMS subs. Note: dbctl-added subs with no ims session are skipped (need the IMS session provisioned first, e.g. via webui).
close_reason: FIXED + verified 2026-07-18. Set real GBR/MBR on the IMS subscribers' 5QI-1 (44/64 Kbps) and 5QI-2 (512/2048 Kbps) session PCC rules in mongo (were unit-only/value-0). Post-fix VoNR call: the SMF's 'No need to send Session Modification Request / qos_flow_created:0 rule_count:0' warning (binding.c:722) — present on both pre-fix calls (01:38, 02:08) — is ABSENT for the post-fix call (02:23), and the AMF issued /nsmf-pdusession/modify for both UEs. In Open5GS's logging model that warning fires ONLY on the no-flow branch, so its absence = the SMF sent the modification and created the dedicated flow. Two-way audio confirmed. Phone-side can't show fiveQi=1 (Android doesn't expose the modem's voice DRB). Fix also covers the Rx/VoLTE bearer path (same pcc_rule GBR; pre-fix also logged 'No need to send Update Bearer Request'). REPRODUCIBILITY: subscriber provisioning (webui/dbctl) leaves pcc_rule GBR at 0 — provisioning must set these values.

title: RCS foundation: PKI/TLS strategy (own-domain LE + lab CA)
description: Cannot get public certs (Let's Encrypt/ACME) for *.pub.3gppnetwork.org — GSMA delegates those zones to the operator holding the MCC/MNC; ACME can't prove control. Strategy: (1) host every MOVABLE endpoint (entitlement, FT-HTTP, XCAP, KDS, config-referenced URIs) under a domain we OWN (e.g. *.rcslab.<ours>) with real LE certs — spec-legal since these URLs are provisioned. (2) The 2 SPEC-FIXED names (config.rcs.* and aes.*, UE-derived from IMSI) need split-horizon DNS + a private lab root CA. Stock devices won't trust a user-CA (system apps ignore user store; system-store install needs root which breaks Play Integrity). BUT our own UP3.0 app can ship a networkSecurityConfig trusting the lab CA — clean escape, no rooting. MSRP-over-TLS needs NO CA (SDP a=fingerprint self-signed).
notes: openrcs-pki CA tooling BUILT + conformance-green (2026-07-18): ~/cellular/openrcs/pki, Rust, 34 tests pass, 0 warnings. Two hierarchies (TLS root -> server leaves incl. spec-fixed config.rcs/aes; RCC.16 Annex A E2EE root/intermediate/client), byte-exact der/x509-cert issuance, in-crate RFC 5280 6.1 path validation. openrcs-common also green (55 tests: identity/Milenage-vs-TS35.208/config-XML/feature-tags). Both have clean history (scaffold->requirements->design->feat). REMAINING for xv1: deploy CA container, generate root, trust in AOSP build, split-horizon serving. Ready to publish (per conformance-green policy) once a GitHub org exists.

title: RCS UP 3.0 interop: SipDelegate app joins lab IMS
description: User's open-source Android RCS app rides the system RCS service + SipDelegate (full UP 3.0) and will register through the platform IMS stack. Network side must 'advertise' RCS properly so Android's system IMS grants the delegate and routes the app's traffic: (1) feature-tag transparency — P/S-CSCF must store+return RCS Contact feature tags (+g.3gpp.icsi-ref oma.cpm.*, +g.3gpp.iari-ref rcs.*, +g.oma.sip-im) in REGISTER/200/reginfo, and MT routing must match on them (Accept-Contact); (2) SIP OPTIONS capability-discovery routing UE<->UE through S-CSCF; (3) MSRP session setup via delegated INVITE (m=message TCP/MSRP) — relay at 172.22.0.21:2855 ready, rtpengine bypass in place; direct UE<->UE MSRP also routable in-lab; (4) TLS (TCP/TLS/MSRP) + MSRP digest auth for closer UP compliance; (5) possibly carrier-config/provisioning knobs on device so system IMS enables RCS w/o ACS. Test with the app on both UEs once attached.
notes: ACS decision (user asked 2026-07-17): NO ACS needed — P-CSCF discovery comes via PCO on the IMS PDN (SipDelegate rides platform registration); RCS service flags live in the user's UP3.0 app; the real gate is DEVICE-side: carrier_rcs_provisioning_required_bool=false + single-registration keys, best delivered by giving the app carrier privileges via ARA-M applet on the sysmoISIM test SIMs (app can then set carrier config + satisfy ProvisioningManager itself). Optional future: mini-ACS = static RCC.07 XML behind config.rcs.mnc001.mcc001.pub.3gppnetwork.org (dns pub_3gpp_zone already has the aes entitlement record pattern) — only if an unmodified commercial UP client is ever wanted.

title: Finish LTE & NR IMS coexistence (verify cross-RAT calling)
description: Largely delivered by the rebase + re-landed decision layer. Remaining = integration test: register one LTE UE (Rx) and one NR UE (N5) to the same P-CSCF in DEPLOY_MODE=ALL, place LTE<->NR calls both directions, confirm correct policy interface chosen per UE and PANI-absent in-dialog/MT fallback works. Effort S-M.
notes:
Pre-UE verification complete (2026-07-17): (1) BSF discovery API live-tested — full binding lifecycle 404/201/200/204/404 OK; (2) UERANSIM UE (imsi-001011234567895, provisioned via open5gs-dbctl, OP not OPc!) attached via sim gNB — PDU session 192.168.100.2, user plane pings; (3) REAL open5gs PCF auto-registered BSF binding for the session (GET returned 200 + pcf endpoint) — core design assumption CONFIRMED; (4) SIP REGISTER injection: POLICY_IF: N5 (BSF binding) for bound IP, Rx for unbound; (5) BSF-error fallback path also observed working (PANI layer). Found+fixed: http_client header strings must NOT end with \r\n (trailing separator => empty header => curl 55 on HTTP/2). Remaining: real phones, cross-RAT calls.
Live-UE testing underway 2026-07-18: two real Pixel 6 phones attached on 5G NR with data (IMSI 116330->192.168.100.4, 116331->192.168.100.3, both DNN internet, confirmed in AMF/SMF logs). RF wall cleared by USB rearrangement + phone repositioning. gNB B210 TX errors were pure USB bandwidth contention (phones shared its bus) — fixed. Now driving: IMS registration -> VoNR between the two phones -> NR/LTE coexistence (the POLICY_IF Rx/N5 verdicts on real devices). Delegated to background bring-up agent.
Phase 3 (cross-RAT Rx/N5) BLOCKED 2026-07-18 on physical eNB B210 (8003310) USB3 fault — see [[enb-b210-usb3-fault]]. Phases 1-2 done: both phones IMS-registered VoNR/N5, two-device VoNR call with two-way audio + N5 both legs. Coexistence phone-side method proven (binary set-allowed-network-types). Remaining: human moves eNB B210 to solid USB3 port, then agent re-locks 6000CS to LTE, IMS-registers over LTE (expect Rx path), places cross-RAT call, captures both POLICY_IF verdicts.
close_reason: DONE — LTE/NR IMS coexistence verified end-to-end on real hardware 2026-07-18. Cross-RAT call between two Pixel 6: 6000CS(LTE/eNB Band7) <-> 600071(NR/gNB n78), two-way audio. P-CSCF BSF-based policy selection chose the correct interface per leg on the SAME call: POLICY_IF N5 for the NR UE (192.168.101.13) + Rx for the LTE UE (192.168.101.18), on INVITE and UPDATE. LTE UE IMS-registered via Rx, NR UE via N5. Validates commit c746fbb (policy_if.cfg + BSF) + the rebase. Follow-up bug: 5QI-1 GBR flow gap (docker_open5gs-2ig).

title: VoNR call between two devices on one USRP B210
description: NOT a capacity/routing problem — 2x AMR-WB 5QI-1 ~110kbps on 51-PRB/20MHz n78 is trivial; IMS already routes UE<->UE VoNR (S-CSCF orig->term loopback + N5/5QI-1 + rtpengine present). REAL WORK = B210 RF/timing: keep external clock/GPSDO, run srsran_performance (avoid Late/underflow), TX power ~16dBm (may need amp), provision 2 IMS subscribers (IMSI/K/OPc in mysql UDM/UDR + pyHSS IMPU/IMPI). No IMS code changes expected. Effort S-M.
notes: VALIDATED LIVE 2026-07-18: real two-device VoNR call between two Pixel 6 (IMSI 116330 @192.168.101.13 <-> 116331 @192.168.101.14) on one B210 gNB. pcscf logs show INVITE with POLICY_IF N5 (BSF binding) + MO_N5_CALL_PCF_POLICY_AUTH + MT_N5_CALL_PCF_POLICY_AUTH both 'N5 QoS Session created 201', plus UPDATE. Capacity was never the issue (as predicted). Real work was COTS IMS enablement — see [[vonr-cots-pixel-deployment]].
close_reason: DONE — two-device VoNR on one B210 verified live 2026-07-18. Real Pixel-to-Pixel VoNR call over n78, two-way audio, N5 policy both legs. Capacity was never the constraint (as predicted); the work was COTS IMS enablement ([[vonr-cots-pixel-deployment]]). Follow-up: 5QI-1 GBR (docker_open5gs-2ig).

title: MSRP-over-TLS (TCP/TLS/MSRP) for RCS media
description: RFC 4976 wants TLS for MSRP. Load kamailio tls module for the relay (already compiled), add tls listener, SDP a=fingerprint (self-signed SHA-256, RFC 4572) — NO public CA needed, so no PKI dependency. Closes the RFC-4976 gap flagged when the plain-TCP relay (:2855, commit 62f7966) was built. Small.

title: RCS group chat / CPM messaging AS (fork SylkServer)
description: OSS verdict: FORK SylkServer (AG Projects, GPL-3.0, alive 2026 — closest living MSRP group-chat focus: ad-hoc multiparty MSRP rooms + FT + focus semantics). NOT CPM as-is: no OMA CPM feature tags, no Message Store (RCC.09), no deferred delivery / store-and-forward for offline UEs, no Contribution-ID/re-join persistence. Add those. Alt substrate: OpenSIPS msrp_ua/msrp_gateway/b2b (C/script). THE LONG POLE of the RCS program. Needed for group chat AND (later) as the ordered MLS Delivery Service for group E2EE. 1:1 chat does NOT need this (direct MSRP via relay already works).

Build HTTP(S) server doing (1) server-side EAP-AKA against lab Milenage keys (reuse pyHSS Milenage / hlr_auc_gw / hostapd EAP-AKA server) and (2) return VERS/TOKEN/APPLICATION docs for app IDs ap2003 VoWiFi/ap2004 VoLTE/ap2005 SMSoIP/ap2009 ODSA (+RCS). FQDN aes.mnc001.mcc001.pub.3gppnetwork.org already in DNS -> ENTITLEMENT_SERVER_IP; Android reads URL from CarrierConfig KEY_ENTITLEMENT_SERVER_URL_STRING (movable). Wire a container at 172.22.0.30. Spec TS.43 v13 public w/ full XML/JSON examples.

title: RCS presence & capability discovery (OPTIONS + XCAP/RLS)
description: OSS verdict: USE Kamailio presence/xcap_server (+OpenXCAP standalone option, actively maintained). OPTIONS-based capability discovery (UP default) = pure CSCF feature-tag routing (+g.3gpp.icsi-ref/iari-ref Contact/Accept-Contact) — mostly already in our CSCFs, needs verification + OPTIONS responder/cache. For presence path: S-CSCF already loads presence; modules.lst compiles presence/pua/xcap_server but EXCLUDES rls (needed for buddy-list SUBSCRIBE) — re-enable + rebuild. Define RCS presence service tuples (org.3gpp.urn:urn-7:3gpp-application.ims.iari.rcse...) in pres-rules. Ties to feature-tag transparency on docker_open5gs-hye.

title: E2EE: MLS KeyPackage directory (KDS) for RCS
description: GSMA UP 3.0 E2EE is MLS-based (RFC 9420); ciphertext rides existing CPIM/MSRP transport untouched (relay verified opaque). The ONE new network element is a KeyPackage directory (KDS): POST /keypackages (publish per IMPU/MSISDN), GET fetch-and-consume single-use packages + reusable last-resort package; store in existing mysql/mongo; DNS kds.ims.mnc001... entry. Identity binding: start with per-subscriber tokens provisioned alongside SIMs, harden later (SIP-digest/IMS-derived). NO ACS needed (app carries KDS URL/enable flag). 1:1 E2EE needs ONLY this + app-side MLS (OpenMLS/mls-rs). GROUP E2EE additionally requires an ordered Delivery Service = the CPM group-chat/messaging AS (separate, large, needed for group RCS regardless of crypto). Legacy Google Signal-protocol E2EE: proprietary/unjoinable, out of scope.
notes: Spec = GSMA RCC.16 v3.0 (19 Feb 2026, public, non-confidential). Client<->KDS API is VENDOR-SPECIFIC in spec (invent ours, shape from OpenMLS delivery-service/ds). Inter-KDS federation IS fully specified (Annex B inter-kds.proto, gRPC+mTLS 1.3) — implement to-spec for 2 federated lab KDSes. Reuse OpenMLS (Rust, MIT, audited) for KeyPackage parse/validate + test-client crypto; add storage+TLS1.3+Annex-A.3 client-cert enrolment. home_kds is a GSMA vendor-ID integer (provisioned via ACS), not URL. Group E2EE additionally needs CPM AS as ordered Delivery Service.

title: ACS (RCC.14/RCC.07 autoconfiguration) for spec-complete RCS
description: Only needed for the 'unmodified spec-following UE' goal (iOS RCS stack, OEM UP clients — NOT stock Google Messages, which is Jibe-locked regardless). Scope: (1) HTTP container serving per-subscriber RCC.07 XML (service flags, cap-discovery policy, chat/FT params, E2EE KDS URL) generated from pyHSS/mysql; RCC.14 vers/validity semantics. (2) DNS: config.rcs.mnc001.mcc001.pub.3gppnetwork.org in dns pub_3gpp_zone (UEs already use lab DNS via SMF — resolves on-net). (3) Identity: header-enrichment analog = source-UE-IP -> subscriber lookup (session state, same pattern as BSF work); SMS-OTP fallback via lab SMSC for off-net. (4) TS.43 entitlement stub (aes DNS record already exists). CAVEATS: HTTPS needs device-trusted CA (lab FQDN can't get public cert — initial HTTP-over-cellular w/ enrichment is allowed, full flow needs CA install on device); ACS becomes the discovery root for the KDS (docker_open5gs-9lp) in this mode.
notes:
OSS: BUILD (confirmed 0 impls — FreeJoyn/jega-ms are empty/config-guides). Crib RCC.07 XML schema from android-rcs/rcsjta (ProvisioningParser/HttpsProvisioningManager) + Hirohumi/rust-rcs-client. RCC.14 flow: HTTP:80 initial (header-enrichment via source-IP->subscriber, our session state) -> HTTP 511 + cookie -> SMS-OTP (lab SMSC!) -> HTTPS:443 config XML. FQDN config.rcs.* is SPEC-FIXED (UE derives from IMSI). Test with rcsjta/rust-rcs-client or our own app, NOT stock Google Messages (Jibe/Play-Integrity gated).

OpenRCS PKI simplification (2026-07-17): user CONTROLS THE UE OS BUILD, so a private lab root CA can be installed in the ANDROID SYSTEM trust store. This dissolves the 'private CA trap' entirely — no rooting/Play-Integrity problem because it's a controlled AOSP build. Implication: a SINGLE internal OpenRCS root CA can sign ALL FQDNs including the two spec-fixed ones (config.rcs.* / aes.*.pub.3gppnetwork.org) that Let's Encrypt CANNOT issue for (GSMA delegation). Let's Encrypt/own-domain becomes OPTIONAL — only needed if testing devices we DON'T control. Recommended: internal CA for the whole lab (fixed + movable FQDNs), skip LE. Split-horizon DNS already set up; SMF PCO DNS must point to lab DNS_IP (bead 04j). See [[openrcs-project-goal]].

VoNR/VoLTE dedicated voice bearer (5QI-1 GBR) requires the IMS subscriber's session PCC rule in mongo to have NON-ZERO gbr/mbr VALUES (Open5GS webui/dbctl provisions the pcc_rule with unit but value=0 => GBR 0 => no dedicated flow). Open5GS PCF ignores the AF qosReference AND marBw; it auto-picks 5QI by media type (audio->1, video->2) and copies GBR from the subscriber pcc_rule matched by qos.index. Set e.g. 5QI-1 gbr 44/mbr 64 Kbps, 5QI-2 gbr 512/mbr 2048 Kbps. Fixed live for 116330/116331 (bead 2ig). Verify via SMF: absence of 'No need to send Session Modification Request'(binding.c:722) on a call = flow created (Open5GS only logs the no-flow branch). Same fix covers Rx/VoLTE (binding.c:344 Update Bearer). Reproducibility gap: bake GBR into subscriber provisioning.

VoNR on COTS Pixel 6 with our stack — VALIDATED LIVE 2026-07-18 (real two-device VoNR call, both legs N5 via BSF binding, POLICY_IF selection confirmed on real hardware). Non-obvious deployment findings: (1) VoLTE/VoNR gated off by default (carrier_config_applied=false, no overlay for PLMN 00101). On userdebug/rooted builds override live WITHOUT OS rebuild via 'cmd phone cc set-value -s 0 -p <key> <val>': carrier_volte_available_bool=true, vonr_enabled_bool=true, vonr_on_by_default_bool=true, enhanced_4g_lte_on_by_default_bool=true, carrier_volte_provisioning_required_bool=false, carrier_ims_gba_required_bool=false. Revert: 'cmd phone cc clear-values -s 0'. (2) KEY: the ims APN MUST be IPv4-only (protocol=IP). Dual-stack IPV4V6 ims APN fails with IP_ADDRESS_MISMATCH(0x77), Shannon modem stays IMS_DEREGISTERED (LBO_PCSCF 0.0.0.0, BLOCK_PDN_BY_INVALID_PCSCF=1) even though framework got PcscfAddresses=[172.22.0.21]. (3) Need an ims-type APN (apn=ims,type=ims) — none preloaded. (4) internet APN: phones shipped apn string 'default' but only DNN internet/ims provisioned -> SMF rejects 'DNN default Not Supported'; fix apn->internet. (5) Cosmetic: Open5GS logs 'Unknown PCO ID (0x2)' (doesn't echo IM CN Subsystem Signaling Flag); UPF masquerades only internet subnet. Phones: 600071=IMSI ...116330/MSISDN 11012026330, 6000CS=...116331/11012026331. IMS pool 192.168.101.0/24. See [[ims-rat-routing-design-2026-07-17-commit]].

eNB B210 (serial 8003310) USB3 fault 2026-07-18: after the USB rearrangement that fixed the gNB B210, the eNB's B210 landed on a USB2-only port. It enumerates as FX3 bootloader (WestBridge, serial 0000000004BE) on Bus 7 @480Mbps; srsenb loads firmware, it briefly appears as B210 on Bus 8 USB3, then floods LIBUSB_TRANSFER_NO_DEVICE and falls back to USB2 bootloader — continuous load/drop/reload. USBDEVFS_RESET + restart does NOT hold. A B210 needs solid USB3 for 50 PRB/23.04 Msps; USB2 can't run it. FIX = physically move serial 8003310 to a solid USB3 port/controller (same remedy that fixed the gNB UMCIE28). The two B210s + USB3 port availability are coupled — fixing one bumped the other. Success = srsenb 'eNodeB started / DL 2680MHz / 50 PRB' with no NO_DEVICE. Secondary: Band 7 SDR coverage weak at phone vs commercial Band 71 macro — LTE UE may need band-lock or stronger Band 7.

IMS RAT routing design (commits c746fbb + header fix): P-CSCF selects Rx-vs-N5 per UE via BSF PCF-binding discovery (pcscf/route/policy_if.cfg): GET http://BSF_IP:7777/nbsf-management/v1/pcfBindings?ipv4Addr=<ue-ip> — 200=5G-anchored=N5, 404=EPC-anchored=Rx. Fallbacks: PANI -> RAT htables (cache) -> Rx. VERIFIED LIVE 2026-07-17: BSF binding lifecycle OK; real PCF auto-registers bindings on PDU session (UERANSIM UE 192.168.100.2); SIP-injection tests show correct N5/Rx verdicts + working PANI fallback on BSF error. GOTCHA: kamailio http_client header strings must NOT end in \r\n (trailing separator => empty header => curl error 55 on HTTP/2 h2c). UERANSIM sub 001011234567895 uses OP (not OPc) — dbctl add stores opc, must flip security.op in mongo. Remaining verification: real phones cross-RAT (docker_open5gs-axd).

Bench radio setup (verified 2026-07-17): NR gNB = LibreSDR B210 serial=UMCIE28 (needs custom srsran/usrp_b220_fpga.bin, copied by srsran_init.sh over usrp_b210_fpga.bin — bigger XC7A200T FPGA); LTE eNB = Zhixun B200 serial=8003310 with srsenb --expert.lte_sample_rates=true. Both on USB3 (they re-enumerate to the USB3 bus only after UHD firmware load — lsusb shows USB2 before that; fx3-state-5 error means flash attempt with wrong FPGA image, fix with USBDEVFS_RESET ioctl). GPSDO on both 10MHz refs currently outputs NOTHING when GPS-unlocked (ref_locked=false both radios) — running clock=internal until fixed. Host quirks: /etc/timezone must exist as a FILE (America/New_York) or compose mounts fail; host ports 8080/8083 taken by user's other stack (pyhss->18080, ocs->18083); docker rejects port ranges in compose 'expose'. Local images must be upstream ghcr pulls (docker_open5gs/kamailio/srsran) — old local builds use the pre-2025 COMPONENT_NAME=nf-1 contract. srsRAN fork 11c9bbab config schema: no threads.non_rt, pdsch_processor_type=[auto,generic,flexible], no nof_*_threads (use max_*_concurrency), lower_phy execution_profile max=triple — 7960X-host.yml rewritten accordingly; other host-configs (7950X/9950X/i9-9900K) still stale-schema, will fail on matching hosts.
